close_reason: Added PartialEq, Eq to ValidationPolicy derive.
description: ValidationPolicy is a public struct containing only primitive fields (u8, u64, bool), all of which implement PartialEq/Eq. Without derives, callers cannot compare policy values in tests or assertions, write policy deduplication logic, or use ValidationPolicy as a map key. The derives are trivially correct and expected on any struct of plain data. Should add #[derive(PartialEq, Eq)].
title: ValidationPolicy missing PartialEq/Eq derives
